nodes.label: The Rise of a New Era
nodes.context: Jamie Patel, a student at Hillcrest Academy, begins his journey in eSports under the guidance of Elevate eSports.

nodes.label: The Legendary Coach
nodes.context: Coach Mariana Garcia, a legendary basketball coach with a controversial past, joins Hillcrest Academy.

nodes.label: The eSports Revolution
nodes.context: Jamie Patel dominates international tournaments, leading to the rise of eSports.

nodes.label: The Clash of Titans
nodes.context: The most awaited sports events of the year, Hillcrest Sports Day and The GSL Finals, take place at Stadium One and Victory Park respectively, showcasing the clash between traditional sports and eSports.
